property_summary: Only calls whose msg.sender equals the stored owner can invoke transferOwnership (reference: require(owner()==msg.sender)); the mutant that uses tx.origin allows a forwarding contract to succeed when tx.origin==owner even though msg.sender (the forwarder) is not the owner.
change_summary: Changed onlyOwner to check against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, allowing different callers (e.g., contracts) to pass the guard and enabling transferOwnership to be invoked by contracts forwarding from the original EOA.
